quote: "Ahoy, matey, keep the meat sizzling and the drinks cold!"
"Arrr, keep yer plates full and yer spirits high!"
"Arr, keep yer provisions dry and yer fire hot, ye scallywag!"
"Keep the fire fed and the plates full, matey,"
"Ahoy, matey, don't forget to keep the rum... I mean, the lemonade... chilled!"
"Avast ye, and mind the slip hazard!"
"Arrr, choose the stone that won't crumble under yer boots!"
"Ye best choose the porcelain for the floor, or ye'll be slip-slidin' into the tub!"
